title: last-converged.json (version 1)
description: Single machine-checkable definition of the persisted last-converged backstop record (AD-36/AD-44); the prose in converge_backstop.py is descriptive. An absent, corrupt, or unknown-version record is treated as changed, never fatal. `converged_at` is additive (P5-1-4): a pre-timestamp v1 record is still valid.
